text: カセキを　みつけたら　ばしょだけ　おしえて　さっさと　かえるんだな！

structure.jp: カセキを　みつけたら
ばしょだけ　おしえて
structure.en: just tell us the place and

structure.jp: さっさと　かえるんだな！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when that happens'. みつけたら = 'if you find it'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: おしえて　さっさと　かえる
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions in order: do this, and then that. おしえて　さっさと　かえる = 'tell us and then go home quickly'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ; said to another person about what they will do, it works as a firm order. かえるんだ = 'you go home'.
